searchText: So I have been lurking and watching the EIP discussions here and I think they are good, but thinking about it why re-invent the wheel here.... there is a pretty well laid out system used in internet protocols of RFC's that you could model it closer to? I believe the process was originally modeled after the IETF? It was before my time. Since then we have iterated on it over time to where it is now, so it may no longer resemble that. @here I just submitted EIP Github Bot PR for review https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3351 <@104006934562107392> What is `ncc`? <@104006934562107392> Answered ☝️ already, no need to. 🙂 Also, I submitted a PR to take care of some minor cleanups: https://github.com/alita-moore/EIPs/pull/3 It has finally happened, the spellchecker is incorrectly failing because it thinks someone's name is a typo: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/1633 How do we bypass the spellchecker? Alternatively, is it realistic to make it not check anything in the author line of the frontmatter? cc <@543900561460822016> Probably just need to add the name to the checker. I don’t think it is trivial to make the spell checker skip the author line
